summary: Follow-ups to Settings and Together: 009c32d (a8ce3c17, lows-only), 01183e5 (af0ecbf9: fix-first for a room's row taking the focus unprompted at every reload) and its fix b9a45b4 (af0ecbf9: lows-only). Open lows: a leave after a profile switch is filed under the new profile; a room made before the first read of the rooms answers can hide that the read failed; a Join button removed while the window is unfocused does not hand focus to its row; Settings: a wrong 'changed on another device' message after a stalled reload; the quiet, danger and is-on ghost button hovers still show when aria-disabled; the acting and mounted refs are set in a passive effect.
